firstPlayerRule: The youngest player goes first, holding Stinky Pig and the die, then pressing the pig’s belly.
houseFallback: If the youngest players are the same age, use the picker.
internalEvidence: Fetched the PlayMonster-hosted rules PDF listed on playmonster.com/rules-and-activity-guide/, which is a scan with no text layer, rendered it to an image and read it. PDF page 1: "Play • The youngest player goes first. Hold Stinky Pig in one hand, and the Die in the other. Press the pig’s belly, and when he starts singing, roll the Die!"
uncertainty: No tie-break is stated for players of the same age.
